matches.note: The promotion's first-ever match; both men were still fighting when the time limit expired, and Green attacked Scarsone after the bell in frustration.
Jensen won with his Doctor Bomb/Tiger Driver combination, The Dreambuster.
Dave was disqualified for throwing salt in Williams's eyes, then chokeslammed him into the timekeeper's table after the bell.
Walsh won by submission with his front-facelock hold, The Guillotine, after a mid-match referee change let St. Clair recover from what would have been a fall.

The main event. Both men traded chair shots before Agony won with a Crucifix Powerbomb; the promotion's own co-presidents then announced a sixteen-man tournament for the still-vacant Unified World Championship.

matches.note: A Bob Dole impersonation angle preceded the match; Dole briefly had Walsh pinned off a bridging German suplex before Walsh won with a spear and The Guillotine, interrupted by Timothy Jensen's own chair shot afterward.
Hutchings won by submission with a Michinoku Driver into a dragon sleeper; MacGregor was taken out on a stretcher afterward with a serious neck injury.
Warren won by countout after St. Clair fell awkwardly onto the ringside steps trying to overpower him.
"Superstar" Ken Warren interfered to take a chair from Scarsone before Scarsone won by submission with the Braincell Killer, setting up a Warren-Scarsone semifinal.

matches.stipulation: Fifteen-man Second-Chance Royal Rumble for the vacant sixteenth tournament spot
matches.note: King Agony wrestled the entire match disguised as a second Ghost-Faced Killer before unmasking near the end. The field narrowed to King Agony and "Boardwalk" Timothy Jensen, both apparently ready to eliminate the other, when the arena lights cut out; when they came back on, both men were outside the ring, simultaneously eliminated by an unseen hand never identified in this record. The promotion's own co-presidents ordered a rematch the following week with both men getting a bye, plus a three-way steel cage escape match against "Human Torture Rack" Ian Walsh.

matches.note: Ghost-Faced Killer attacked the referee and both wrestlers with a steel bar, then forced the groggy referee to count a simultaneous double-pin; the promotion's own co-president declared both men winners, sending both into that night's cage match against "Human Torture Rack" Ian Walsh.
de Sade won by submission with his Spinning Toe Hold; "Brutal" Brian Floyd, still owed revenge from the Royal Rumble, chair-shotted de Sade after the bell.
Mowery won by submission after Mazzotta tapped out.
Henderson pinned Thomas with his Nodowa Bomb, The Thunderbolt, closing out the Ghetto Thunderstorm/For Unlawful Carnal Knowledge feud; a post-match brawl among all four men followed.

Jensen was the first man to climb out of the cage and drop to the floor, eliminating Walsh and Agony from the tournament's final four and advancing to face the Hutchings/Warren-Scarsone semifinal winner.
